title: Gated stored-leaf birthday search on secp256k1, two 55-bit VA ranges, at 123.344741338004922

claims.statement: Gated grouped stored-leaf birthday search (proof.md) recovers x from uniform secp256k1 Q=[x]P w.p. >= 0.39 (Q=O gives x=0). Coordinator 0 halts with no output unless a 128-bit RNDR u < K_GATE = 132824955355900474654180918496400497687 (p_gate ~ 0.390337462); else Phase-0 X-mining (E_mine <= 2^124.3435 insns; no output if a pool has < 4 valid pairs), then q1 = 71,862,600,000 batches in G = 2048 groups on 2^66 generators, 2^41 relays, 2^82 homes (CAP_H = 1,313,229,200,424,960). lo_run >= 0.999135461735, (K_GATE/2^128) lo_run >= 0.390000000001 > 0.39. E_total = 256 + p_gate E_run <= 2^123.344741338004922 units of 1000 AArch64 insns (E_run <= 2^124.701948 units, <= 64.8453 insns/leaf of S = 2^128.648802); memory <= 2^137.9999 B; pre <= 2^115.8110 units; no advice.

experiments.purpose: Checks leaf, Phase-0 and routing kernels on the two-55-bit-VA-range machine (incl. VA-0 wraps), gate, Vandermonde/CS, C132 bound and counts.
